text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Foreign Minister Abderrahim Zouari, attending a meeting on diplomats in Tunisia, stressed their role in boosting cooperation with foreign countries and attracting foreign investors.

- Tunisia on Wednesday signed a cooperation agreement with Arab Radio Television (ART) and Orbit Satellite Television to ensure broadcasting Tunisian TV channel in the Gulf and Latin American countries.
- Italian military vessel "San Giusto" is to stop at "La Goulette" port from August 9-13.
